purpose: Fail-closed staging SRE/continuity evidence gate proving backup, real restore, measured RTO/RPO, load, chaos, alert delivery, telemetry and error budgets.
required_evidence: preregistered SRE policy + independent pre-drill timestamp anchor
real restore drill from that exact backup
restored repository/data hashes equal backup hashes
chaos scenarios with safe-state preservation and zero wagering
error budgets for every required SLO
closure_rule: Synthetic PASS validates the auditor only. H-03 remains OPEN until real staging drills pass with exact evidence.
